newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka blue chips up on tourism, tea income.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka blue chips up on tourism, tea income.

text.p: Shares of two Sri Lankan blue chips rose sharply on Thursday due to good growth expected in tourism and plantation sectors, brokers said.
Shares of John Keells Holdings Ltd rose 4.6 percent or 15 rupees to 340 and Aitken Spence & Co Ltd five rupees or 2.7 percent to 190.
"Both conglomerates are exposed to toursm and plantations, which are seen doing well in 1997," said a broker who declined to be identified.
Income from tea is seen rising on good demand from the Commonwealth of Independent States and Middle East, brokers said.
